citations.anchor: keeps the widget in a trailing catch-all band
citations.why: A widget naming section 'nowhere' still appears, as the last band, with isFallback true — dropping the orphan or folding it into a registered band fails the assertions; the data-section-fallback="true" attribute itself is only asserted negatively (toHaveCount(0)) in the e2e suite.

citations.anchor: drops a band whose every widget is gated out
citations.why: A section whose only widget is permission-gated out is absent from the resolved bands entirely, so nothing downstream can render its heading.

citations.anchor: hides content widgets from a user without content:read
citations.why: Pins the 'heading included' half in the DOM: section('Content') and section('Team') are level-2 heading locators asserted toHaveCount(0) while the still-populated band stays visible.

citations.anchor: an override only replaces the fields it sets
citations.why: A second contribution carrying only defaultTitle wins on that field while order and defaultDescription from the first survive — a whole-object replace fails both surviving-field assertions.

citations.anchor: an override does not move the band
citations.why: Pins the positional clause: re-contributing 'content' last still leaves the band first in the resolved order.

citations.anchor: keeps registration order for items sharing an order
citations.why: Two widgets with no order come back in registration order ['alpha','beta']; an unstable sort or a map-traversal fold fails it. Only the widget axis is exercised — the same rule for sections is not separately pinned.

citations.anchor: sorts an order-less section after the built-ins
citations.why: An order-less section sorts behind one with order 10, so the default cannot be 0 or a mid value; the exact constant 100 and the widget-side default are not separately asserted.

citations.anchor: drops widgets the user lacks the permission for
citations.why: A widget declaring 'content:read' is excluded from the band when the permission set is empty, while an ungated sibling stays.

citations.anchor: still applies permissions to orphaned widgets
citations.why: Pins the second clause: a gated widget naming an unregistered section is filtered out rather than surviving into the fallback band.

citations.anchor: hides content widgets from a user without content:read
citations.why: Pins only the slot-item half — no gated card and no band heading is rendered for a user without the permission. The second half (the data hook's `enabled`, in content-admin/media-admin) is unpinned: no test asserts that no /insights/content/* request goes out.

citations.anchor: a failing widget does not take down the rest of the page
citations.why: content/stale is failed, and StaleEntriesWidget computes isEmpty={total === 0} from undefined data, so both flags are true at once — asserting the error banner visible AND the empty copy absent is exactly the isError-outranks-isEmpty precedence.

citations.anchor: a stat tile that cannot load shows no figure at all
citations.why: With content/totals failing the tile contains an em dash and not a '0' — pins the 'never prints a number' half.

citations.anchor: a failed stat tile says its value is unavailable
citations.why: Pins the second half: the same failed tile carries the sr-only 'Unavailable' text that stands in for the aria-hidden em dash.

citations.anchor: each widget calls its own endpoint
citations.why: Every widget's route is asserted present in the request spy, and content/totals exactly once for its three tiles. The negative half — that the page itself issues no request — is not asserted.

citations.anchor: changing the range refetches the range-dependent widgets
citations.why: Pins the `days` clause: selecting 90d must produce a fresh days=90 request for velocity and uploads, which only happens if days is part of the query key — drop it and TanStack serves the cached 30d entry. The workspace-id-in-the-key clause is unpinned (no test switches workspace and re-reads the numbers).

citations.anchor: falls back to the default on a value it does not offer
citations.why: Pins the unknown-value clause at the parser: '90', '90D', '1y' and '__proto__' all resolve to DEFAULT_RANGE.

citations.anchor: the selected range is in the URL, so the view can be shared
citations.why: Pins the URL-as-source-of-truth and default-not-written clauses end to end: no ?range= on load, ?range=90d after selecting, the selection surviving a reload, and the param removed rather than rewritten when the default is chosen again. The `replace` (no history entry) and merge-with-existing-params clauses are unpinned.

citations.anchor: the document outline has no skipped heading level
citations.why: Asserts exactly one h1, at least one h2 and one h3, and zero h4 inside main — moving any widget title back to h4 fails it. The error boundary's placeholder h3 is pinned separately, in InsightsSectionBand/index.spec.tsx, where a widget is actually made to throw.

insights:I-15.missing: Only the positive half is pinned — every widget's own route is seen in the admin-e2e request spy. The negative clause, that the page itself opens no request, is asserted nowhere: no test enumerates the spy and finds nothing beyond the widgets' routes, so a fetch added to InsightsPage or InsightsSectionBand would pass every suite.

insights:I-16.missing: Pinned for content-admin's six Insights queries (packages/content/admin/src/lib/application/useContentInsights/index.spec.tsx counts two attempts against a client that would otherwise make four). media-admin's three (useMediaInsights) and i18n-admin's one (useLocalizationCoverage) are unpinned: neither package has a test target, so reverting their retry: 1 to the default still breaks nothing.

insights:I-17.missing: Only the `days` clause is pinned (admin-e2e sees a fresh days=90 request after selecting 90d). The workspace-id-in-the-key clause is unpinned — no test switches workspace and re-reads the numbers — and so is the reason it matters: that the workspace reaches the server only as an X-Workspace-Id header, which a cache hit never sends.

insights:I-23.missing: The scan in RampLegend/index.spec.tsx reads the English `defaultMessage` literals of every admin source that renders a RampLegend, against a fixed list of brightness comparatives (darker/lighter/brighter/…). It cannot see a caption that arrives from a translation catalogue, one assembled at runtime, or one that names a direction some other way ('the deep end means older').
